sections.title: 2. Scope, Definitions & Account Responsibilities
sections.content:

Access is granted only after successful verification of a captured payment matching the order. Failed, cancelled, pending, or unverified transactions do not unlock digital products.

Purchased access is provided through your customer account vault and protected download links following payment verification. Confirmation emails link directly to your account vault, which remains the primary delivery channel.

This Refund, Cancellation & Payment Policy governs all financial transactions, order cancellations, duplicate payment resolutions, and refund requests on Booyahstudio.

sections.title: 2. Digital Product Nature & General Refund Rule
sections.content: Because Booyahstudio provides digital templates, source code, and downloadable media that cannot be physically returned once accessed, purchases are generally final and non-refundable once payment is captured and digital access is made available in your customer vault, subject to applicable law and legitimate exceptions defined below.

sections.title: 3. Eligible Refund Scenarios & Non-Delivery Situations
sections.content:
A full refund or replacement will be issued under the following circumstances:
• Non-Delivery: Technical failure on our server prevents digital download access after verified payment, and our support team is unable to deliver the files or resolve the issue within 72 hours.
• Major Defect: The downloaded source package contains a critical, unfixable bug or missing core files that prevent usage, and our support team cannot provide a fix or working replacement.
• Duplicate Charging: You were accidentally charged multiple times for a single purchase attempt.

sections.title: 4. Ineligible Scenarios & Download/Access Exceptions
sections.content:
Refunds WILL NOT be granted for:
• Change of mind or buyer’s remorse after files have been downloaded.
• Incompatibility with third-party software, hosting environments, or versions not specified in the published technical requirements.
• Lack of technical skill or developer experience required to modify or deploy the template.
• Unverified claims or failure to provide requested order information.

sections.title: 5. Cancellation Prior to Digital Access
sections.content: You may request cancellation of an order if your payment is debited but the transaction remains pending and no download links or digital vault access have been generated or accessed. Once digital files are accessed or downloaded, cancellation is no longer possible.

sections.title: 6. Duplicate Payments & Payment Error Processing
sections.content:
If you notice multiple debits for a single order due to a network glitch or payment gateway retry, please email connectbooyahstudio@gmail.com with your order ID, payment references, and bank debit proof.

Upon verifying the duplicate capture with Razorpay or the payment processor, we immediately initiate a full refund for the extra charge to the original payment instrument within 5–7 business days.

sections.title: 7. Refund Request Procedure & Review Timeline
sections.content:
To request a refund, submit an email to connectbooyahstudio@gmail.com within 7 days of purchase containing:
1. Order ID and Razorpay Payment ID
2. Email address associated with the purchase
3. Detailed explanation of the technical issue or duplicate debit

Requests are evaluated within 2 business days. Approved refunds are credited back to the original payment method (UPI, card, net banking) within 5–7 business days as per banking standards.

sections.title: 8. Payment Gateways, Verification & Transaction Security
sections.content: All online payments are processed securely via PCI-DSS compliant payment gateways (such as Razorpay). We verify all transactions server-side before granting digital access. If a payment is debited but fails server verification, Razorpay or your bank will automatically auto-refund the amount according to banking turnaround times.

sections.title: 9. Interaction with Chargebacks & Payment Disputes
sections.content: We encourage customers to contact our support team directly to resolve payment errors quickly. If a chargeback or payment dispute is raised with a bank while a refund request is open, the payment processor handles the dispute, and refund processing through our portal may be paused until the bank dispute is concluded.
